listitem.para: Per-connection log file path. When set, all log messages for this connection (and its states) are written exclusively to the specified file instead of the global log destination (syslog or pluto's global log file). The file is opened in append mode when the connection is loaded and closed when it is deleted. Child connections (instances and group instances) do not inherit this setting.

The log file of a loaded connection can be changed at runtime, without deleting and re-adding it, with ipsec whack --name conn --conlogfile path (an empty path returns the connection to the global log). This never adds a connection and does not affect its IKE or IPsec SAs; all of them switch to the new file immediately. The change lasts until pluto restarts or the connection is added again from the configuration.
After log rotation, send SIGHUP to pluto (or use the postrotate directive in logrotate) to make pluto reopen both the global log file and all per-connection log files.
